snippet.title: Ghoul Panic Arcade
snippet.description:
The story for Ghoul Panic is quite simple. The evil witch Witchina, along with her evil minions, has taken over the town and turned all of the villagers into yellow cats, she has taken up residence in a local mansion and it is up to the two heroes Kevin and Lisa, two people who were turned into cats but happened to have guns on them at the time, to defeat Witchina and return the town to normal.

Ghoul Panic is a simple gallery shooter game, the game is played with a lightgun, where the player must shoot the given targets on the screen. The main targets are ghosts, skeletons and other monsters, with most missions requiring that the player shoot a specific number of enemies. Later missions introduce targets which the player must avoid shooting, such as the cats which must be protected and bomb-shaped monsters. 

The player can pick between three difficulty levels, with Practice being only 6 stages long, while on Medium and Advanced the player plays through all stages. The game features various mission types:

Target Shooting: The most common type of mission, the player must shoot a specific number of enemies before the timer runs out.

Object Destruction: The player is given a single target which it much shoot continuously to either destroy it or push it into a designated place.

 Cat Rescue: The player must shoot enemies to prevent them from reaching the cats.

Accuracy Shooting: The Player must shoot a given target with limited ammo.

Boss Fight: After beating four missions the player faces a boss. These play much like the boss fights from the House of the Dead series, where the player must hit a specific part of the boss while deflecting it's attacks.
